verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents per-sync field mapping: each sync connects one model to one destination and defines how rows map into it. That gives some per-destination control over which attributes are sent, which is a thin form of field-level filtering. Nothing in the evidence covers hashing or masking. Missing for 10: documented hashing of PII per destination, masking/redaction of sensitive fields, an explicit privacy-oriented field-filtering control, and independent corroboration.
